mappings.rationale: Attacker gathers information about capabilities and exposure.
mappings.caveat: Conversation is one possible interface, not a required or universally available one.

mappings.rationale: Payload or malicious-service preparation may precede delivery.
mappings.caveat: Resource preparation is not itself prompt injection; this is a narrative grouping.

mappings.rationale: An injected input may provide an initial foothold in an application workflow.
mappings.caveat: Other initial-access methods exist; delivering text does not establish control.

mappings.rationale: Access to model interfaces may enable probing or input delivery.
mappings.caveat: Model access is not equivalent to reconnaissance and can be a prerequisite.

mappings.rationale: Redirected execution can implement an attacker-requested action.
mappings.caveat: Hijacked output is not proof that a tool executed; validate action traces.

mappings.rationale: Durable instruction or configuration changes may influence future runs.
mappings.caveat: Persistence is conditional on storage, retrieval and subsequent behavior.

mappings.rationale: A malicious instruction may attempt to avoid a defensive check during redirection.
mappings.caveat: Behavioral redirection does not automatically imply defense evasion.

mappings.rationale: After gaining access, an attacker may discover tools or resources.
mappings.caveat: Discovery after access and external reconnaissance are distinct tactics.

mappings.rationale: Data collection may supply a later disclosure step.
mappings.caveat: Collection is not exfiltration; an unauthorized recipient must receive the data.

mappings.rationale: Attack preparation or positioning may support the illustrated input path.
mappings.caveat: A broad tactic association does not assign every staging technique to injection.

mappings.rationale: Credentials may enable further access or themselves be disclosed.
mappings.caveat: Credential access can occur without privilege escalation.

mappings.rationale: A deputy or other path can provide effective authority beyond the originating principal.
mappings.caveat: Misuse of existing permissions is not automatically escalation.

mappings.rationale: Delegation can bridge components and sometimes reach different authority.
mappings.caveat: Lateral movement does not necessarily increase privilege.

mappings.rationale: Protected information reaches an unauthorized recipient.
mappings.caveat: An output that the attacker cannot observe is not that exfiltration path.

mappings.rationale: Unauthorized actions can have integrity, confidentiality or availability consequences.
mappings.caveat: The six-stage model does not cover every impact, including fraud or physical harm.

mappings.rationale: A durable callback can be one route for continued attacker direction.
mappings.caveat: Command and control can exist without persistence; the association is conditional.
